done.ref: D9 · F041 · F073 · F201 · new:versions-menus:False Changed in another tab after a quick reload · new:fresh-phone:A pick made <1s before a reload is lost
done.what: Editor side of the D9 contract. On visibilitychange→hidden and on pagehide every dirty room is sent with fetch('/visualizer/state', {method:'POST', keepalive:true, JSON {roomId, pending, detection, baseRev}}) (bodies ≤ 60 KB, 64 KB budget across rooms; a bigger one falls back to the server action on hidden). A draft om.viz.draft.<roomId> = {baseRev, pending, detection, at} is written to sessionStorage at the same time. On load, a draft younger than 2 minutes whose baseRev equals the loaded stateRev (and differs from what was loaded) becomes the room's picks and is saved as usual; every other draft is dropped. A keepalive reply is handled like the action's (same JSON); a late reply never walks a revision back. An in-flight map stops pagehide re-sending a room that the hidden flush already sent. The unmount/Back flush and leave() are kept.

done.ref: new:surfaces-furniture:The snackbar's Undo does nothing once another step lands

A stale snackbar Undo (Changes cleared, … taken off the list, Reference taken off, Treated as a photo) says 'Newer changes came after that — use Undo to step back' instead of doing nothing. The house snackbar has no dismiss handle, so older snackbars can't be withdrawn (see notDone).

Tools lights only for pending.tool; a typed note is counted in 'n changes' only. (The panel's empty '→' line is in surfaces-panel.tsx, owned by rail.)

The 'Vn is ready' snackbar is one line. The whole-room caveat stays in the rail's hint. The lift now counts only what the snackbar would cover sideways: beside a narrow centred canvas bar (wide windows), it rests above the strip and off the photo.

After a run, focus on the fading progress card counts as nowhere, so the keyboard lands on the new tile (after a cancel or an error, on Generate). This is compatible with stage.tsx's own afterRun. Pin cards return focus when they close: to their opener (a marker, or the photo → the Pin toggle), to the new pin's marker after 'Pin it', and to the Pin toggle after Remove. Focus is only moved when nothing holds it.

done.ref: critic-4 · new:code-robustness:A closed lead's design still offers Share
done.what: The editor reads data.design.leadClosed (from the loader). Share with client is disabled with LEAD_CLOSED_SHARE ('This lead was returned or deleted — its links stay off') in its tooltip. The version menu's 'Share with the client…' row is disabled with the same words as its meta line. The moodboard's Share says it in a snackbar instead of closing quietly.
A design with no rooms or renders reads 'Saved …' from its own updatedAt/createdAt.

A surface or piece marked by hand now carries markedOn (the version key it was marked on, or ORIGINAL): on tap, draw, redraw and add piece. The new pure helpers pictureOf / onPicture in editor-model.ts work out which picture a version shows. A new picture starts at a restyle, a furnished look or a rendered sketch; everything else inherits its parent's. A hand mark from another picture is left out of the reading, the markers, the tab dots and Generate, so a whole-room look shows its empty state. Older marks without markedOn read as before. Unit-checked with tsx (10 cases).

A tapped surface is read twice: with its own ±0.2 box and with a ±0.35 box. If the region grows past the tap's box (wide > 1.15× tight and more than 0.2% of the photo), the box's straight edges were cutting it off, so the tap goes to tracing ('This spread too far — trace its outline instead'). A tap can no longer save a rectangle. Simulated on the three sample rooms with growRegion: on a 9×9 tap grid, 40–57 of the ~70 old 'keeps' per room were box-clipped and now trace; 16–34 stay.

verification: Ran npx tsc --noEmit -p . (clean for the whole repo at the end; an engine mid-edit error in run.ts came and went and was not mine) and npx eslint on every package file (visualizer-editor.tsx, use-editor-state.ts, editor-model.ts, topbar.tsx, skeletons.tsx, app/(editor)/visualizer, lib/nav.ts): clean. Unit-checked the new pure helpers with tsx (scratch t-picture.mts): pictureOf and onPicture across edit, restyle, relight-of-a-look, restyle-of-a-look and a missing parent, plus the filtered copy — 10/10 pass; boxAround's only diff was float noise. Simulated the F023 tap probe with the engine's growRegion on the three sample photos (t-tap.mts, t-grid.mts). Wall, ceiling and art taps that used to save ±0.2 rectangles (13–14% of the photo, growing to 28–33% with room) now route to tracing. Contained regions stay; on a 9×9 grid, 16–34 taps per room still keep. Checked that Next 16's patched history.replaceState skips the router sync when the state carries __NA. That is why the old replaceState(window.history.state) lost the room on router.refresh(); passing null syncs it. Checked the CSS files' brace balance and that the new selectors are CSS-module pure.
